baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second-person plural imperfect تَذَرُونَ (و ذ ر) governs ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ (ء خ ر).
baseline_models.mechanism: The leaving/letting-be branch makes the clause an ongoing agentive release, while the later-or-other branch identifies what is released.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or letting something be supplies deliberate relinquishment as the governing action.
What is later or other than the first supplies the relinquished object as the latter reality.

changed_reading.before: You merely fail to attend to the afterlife.
changed_reading.after: You keep actively letting the latter reality go.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَذَرُونَ is paired directly with the temporal noun ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Leaving combines with deferral: the latter is not denied as nonexistent but continually assigned to a later time and therefore denied present force.

activation_trace.role: Letting something be supplies the practical suspension of engagement.
Postponement to a later time turns the object into something repeatedly deferred.

changed_reading.after: You neutralize the future by always postponing its claim on the present.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The material branch of و ذ ر and the posterior branch of ء خ ر remain attached to the two focus words.
baseline_models.mechanism: A detached piece combines with a rear part: the latter is imagined as a posterior segment that can be separated from the currently valued whole.

activation_trace.role: A detached morsel or piece supplies the image of severability.
The rear or posterior part locates the detached object behind the preferred foreground.

changed_reading.before: You leave a later time unattended.
changed_reading.after: You treat the posterior end of existence as though it were a detachable remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: Will projects boundary-breaking forward, while acceleration brings value near and heart-attachment fixes desire on it; leaving the latter is thus the downstream act of an organized temporal appetite, not a passive lapse.

activation_trace.role: Active leaving supplies the result produced by the appetite sequence.
Deferral supplies the temporal target displaced by what is accelerated.
Will and desire supply the initiating drive rather than accidental forgetfulness.
Breaching right and protective bounds makes forward desire a transgressive route.
Frontness and nearness give the desire a forward spatial vector.
Haste and bringing-forward define the preferred object by accelerated availability.
Love fixed in the heart supplies the attachment that sustains temporal preference.

structural_cues: 75:5 projects transgression 'ahead of him'; 75:20-21 then coordinates loving the urgent with leaving the later under an adversative correction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies will, breach, forwardness, acceleration, and heart-attachment. I infer a drive-to-preference-to-abandonment arrow; a live alternative is that these are parallel symptoms rather than a causal chain.

changed_reading.before: You happen to neglect what comes later.
changed_reading.after: You cultivate a forward-rushing attachment whose practical output is continual abandonment of the later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired report of what a person advanced and deferred turns temporal relegation into a record-producing act: what is put later is not erased but returns as disclosed history.

activation_trace.role: Leaving supplies the attempted removal from present concern.
Deferral supplies the focus model that the report sequence revises.
Advancing and precedence supply the first pole of the disclosed temporal ledger.
Deferring to a later time supplies the ledger's held-back counterpart.

structural_cues: 75:13 places قَدَّمَ and أَخَّرَ in an antithetical pair governed by what the human will be told.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reported pair of advanced and deferred acts. I infer that relegating the later generates recoverable account rather than absence; alternatively, 75:13 may classify deeds without modifying ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ itself.

changed_reading.before: Putting the later aside removes it from the operative field.
changed_reading.after: Every act of putting the later aside enters the very deferred record that will return to speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus makes humans agents who leave; the closing question makes the human the prospective patient of being left and denies that release. Abandoning the latter therefore cannot make accountability abandon the agent.

activation_trace.role: Agentive leaving establishes the first direction of release.
The latter reality is the object humans attempt to leave.
Release or clearing away supplies the denied reciprocal condition of the human being left free.

structural_cues: 75:36 changes the human from subject of leaving to grammatical patient in أَن يُتْرَكَ and frames that expectation as a rhetorical question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active leaving in 75:21 and passive being-left in 75:36. I infer a deliberate agent-patient reversal; alternatively, the two leaving verbs may support separate arguments without reciprocal wordplay.

changed_reading.before: You can leave the later behind as a unilateral choice.
changed_reading.after: You may leave the later, but you are not thereby left: the attempted release is structurally nonreciprocal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial becomes bodily turning, departure toward the familiar social group, and swaggering extension; the temporal preference of 75:21 is enacted as a repeatable retreat posture.

activation_trace.role: Leaving supplies the abstract action that the later sequence embodies.
The posterior image supplies what the body turns its back toward.
Attributing the message to falsehood supplies the retreat's epistemic initiation.
Turning one's back and withdrawing converts rejection into bodily orientation.
Going and passing on supply continued motion away from the demand.
The group of kin and belonging supplies the familiar social destination of retreat.
Swaggering through extended posture supplies defiant affect to the departure.

structural_cues: 75:31-33 progresses from failure to affirm and pray, through denial and turning away, to movement toward family and swagger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a denial-to-turning-to-social-return sequence. I infer these acts instantiate تَذَرُونَ as an embodied habit; alternatively, they may portray one consequence of rejection without expanding the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: Leaving the later is an inward preference about time.
changed_reading.after: Leaving the later is a whole posture: deny, turn the back, retreat into familiarity, and carry the body as though no reckoning approaches.

context_deltas.mechanism: The supposedly posterior object becomes a face-forward field: faces present themselves, sight is directed, and the person is driven toward lordly destination. Spatial avoidance is answered by unavoidable orientation.

activation_trace.role: Leaving supplies the attempted spatial and practical disengagement.
The rear or posterior part supplies the spatial model being reversed.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the destination as one the traveler does not control.
The face and front surface make the future visibly present rather than posterior.
Directed sight or insight supplies active orientation toward what had been relegated.
Driving and urging supply forced transit toward the destination.

structural_cues: 75:22-24 repeats faces; 75:23 and 75:30 repeat movement toward the Lord, first through looking and then through the driven destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies front-facing, directed sight, driving, and lordship. I infer a spatial counterforce to the focus's posterior branch; alternatively, the scenes may simply describe the destination after a separate condemnation.

changed_reading.before: You place the latter behind you and proceed without it.
changed_reading.after: What you place behind you becomes the front-facing destination toward which you are driven.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's detached and cut-piece images meet a body that is gathered from hard pieces and restored to complete form. The later cannot be severed from embodied identity as a disposable remainder.

activation_trace.role: A detached morsel or piece supplies the material model of separation.
Cutting material or scoring a wound intensifies separation as an incision into a whole.
The posterior part supplies the segment imagined as expendable.
Joining what was scattered into one whole directly counters detachment.
Hard bone supplies the separated bodily material subject to regathering.
Integrity and completion in the thing itself supply restored wholeness down to form.

structural_cues: 75:3-4 asks about gathering bones and restoring fingertips; 75:38-40 repeats forming and reviving at the surah's close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies detached/cut-piece images and a gather-bone-complete sequence. I infer that reassembly refutes imagined severability between present body and later identity; alternatively, the material senses of و ذ ر may be too branch-distant for more than an exploratory echo.

changed_reading.before: The later can be cut off as a separate remainder of life.
changed_reading.after: The surah answers attempted detachment with exact reassembly: the discarded remainder returns as the same embodied subject.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ most readily names the afterlife, not a later recitational segment. It remains anchored in the focus's leave/later construction and in the immediately preceding haste-read-follow-explain sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary discourse echo, never as a replacement referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَذَرُونَ can mark dropping something, while the later-or-other branch of ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ can momentarily echo what follows in an ordered delivery.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or letting be supplies the act of dropping an ordered remainder.
What is later or other than the first supplies the possible sequence echo.
Haste and premature advancement supply pressure to move ahead of delivery.
Reading and recitation supply the ordered verbal process within which something later can be dropped.
Following after supplies the required sequence that haste disrupts.
Disclosure of meaning supplies the later explanatory completion at risk of being bypassed.

changed_reading.before: The clause only contrasts present life with afterlife.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, it also diagnoses the same haste as dropping what comes later in a divinely ordered act of reception.

strongest_changes: The immediate and earlier context changes passive neglect into an appetite-driven temporal process: will and heart-attachment accelerate the urgent and produce abandonment of the later.
The advanced/deferred report shows that relegation creates a recoverable record rather than erasure.
The passive reversal at 75:36 makes leaving nonreciprocal: humans leave the latter but are not themselves left free.
The face, gaze, and driven-destination sequence turns what was placed behind into an unavoidable front-facing encounter.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package activated temporal, grammatical, bodily, spatial, and material countermodels around the two-word focus without requiring them to collapse into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The detached-piece and cutting branches of و ذ ر are visibly anchored but substantially more form-distant than the ordinary leaving branch.
The recitation-sequence model may be a local structural echo rather than a deliberately doubled reference.
The posterior and deferral senses of ء خ ر may enrich ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ without competing with its direct afterlife reference.
